text:
mia_cs: Quick sync — CypressAI onboarding call finished. They reported p95 tail on chat generation ~2.3s for user-facing requests (700–900 token context). They're currently on rwd-falcon-7b-16k (no quant). Renewal watch: usage upswing but latency is causing friction. Thinking a targeted perf experiment: small canary with quantized model + routing to compact variant during peak. Need SE + ML signoff and an enablement note for customer.

sam_se: +1 to experiment. My suggested quick wins: reduce batching window to 10–15ms, enable prefix KV caching for identical system prompts, and try an int8 quantized build of their current model. Also propose a model-mix route to a compact 7B-8k variant for ~20% of peak traffic.

oliver_ml: Agreed. Caveats: quantization can change subtle generation calibration — we should run a 100-prompt eval set (critical prompts) and compare BLEU/ROUGE-ish signals + manual spot checks. Estimate: int8 -> ~30–40% token cost drop and p95 improvement from 2.3s -> ~1.0–1.3s in our staging perf.

sam_se: Here's a minimal route canary config snippet we can apply via the Console API for a 5% canary: 

```
routes:
  - name: cypress-mix-canary
    models:
      - id: rwd-falcon-7b-8k-quant-int8
        weight: 0.05
      - id: rwd-falcon-7b-16k
        weight: 0.95
canary_window: 48h
autoscale:
  batching_ms: 12
  prefix_cache: true
```

sam_se: We'll monitor these signals: p50/p95/p99 latency, cost per 1k tokens, top-5 error classes (truncation, hallucination, latency timeouts).

oliver_ml: Add rollout/rollback triggers: rollback if any of these occur for 10+ minutes: token cost > prior by 10% and quality metric delta (avg eval score) < -0.02, or p95 increases vs baseline. Also we should run an A/B quality check against the 100-critical prompts and threshold at 95% pass rate.

lara_pm: Timeline ask: can we get a preflight + customer enablement note by EOD tomorrow? Customer wants a short one-pager showing expected perf change, risk checklist, and how we’ll revert. I'll own the one-pager with inputs from you all.

mia_cs: I'll call the customer tomorrow AM and pitch the canary. Action items: sam -> prepare canary config + infra checklist; oliver -> run eval on quantized build and share results (diffs + examples); lara -> draft one-pager; i'll schedule 30m sync w/ CypressAM & include support on standby.

infra-bot: Deployment preview created: https://console.redwood.ai/deploys/preview/cypress-canary-1779991234 (logs streaming).

sam_se: I'll put the config and runbook in the shared doc: https://redwoodinternals/repo/cypress-canary (SE checklist + curl snippets). Quick curl to set route: 

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/routes \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"name":"cypress-mix-canary","config":{...}}'
```

oliver_ml: I'll attach the eval diff in the doc by noon. If quantized outputs show <1% semantic regressions on the eval set, we greenlight canary. If it's between 1–3% we run a human spot-check on 50 examples.

mia_cs: OK — tagging owners: @sam_se (canary + infra), @oliver_ml (eval + rollback rules), @lara_pm (customer-facing note). I'll update the customer after we have the initial eval.

lara_pm: I'll have the one-pager draft by 5pm PST. Include a small table: expected p95, expected cost delta, rollback conditions, contact points.

sam_se: Tiny add: for peak routing we can set time-of-day routing weights to favor compact at 9am–11am PST based on their traffic spike. I'll include that optional snippet.

mia_cs: Great. If all goes well, propose we expand from 5% -> 20% after 48h with green signals. Thanks team :thumbsup:

oliver_ml: Noted. I'll include a short list of high-risk prompts to exclude from canary (legal/PII-sensitive prompts) so sensitive traffic stays on the full model.

mia_cs: Perfect. I'll close the loop post-eval.

sam_se: ack.

infra-bot: Canary job started at 1779991255. Logs: https://console.redwood.ai/logs/canary/1779991255

mia_cs: thanks — will monitor and update the customer after first 2h window. :eyes:
